package.author: COING Inc.
package.description: A time tracker and timesheet app that lets you track work hours across projects.

en-US.author: COING Inc.
en-US.description: A time tracker and timesheet app that lets you track work hours across projects.
en-US.name: Clockify
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's improved:
- Screenshots are now stored in the local database.
- Improved the notification message displayed to banned users.
What's fixed:
- Fixed an issue causing time zone mismatches.
- Fixed missing time entries issue.
- Fixed an issue where the "No internet connection" banner appeared despite an active connection.
- Fixed an issue causing the app to freeze.
